page_title: EVE 1-1 FUL | Everton v Fulham 26/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Harrison Reed (Fulham) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
90+7' Harrison Reed (Fulham) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
90+6' John Brooks blows for a foul after Beto (Everton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

90+4' 1 - 1 Beto (Everton) scores a goal! A perfectly produced cross puts him one-on-one with the goalkeeper and he plants a brilliant header down in the middle of the net, leaving the goalkeeper beaten!
90+3' Michael Keane (Everton) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post.
90+2' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jorge Cuenca (Fulham) replacing Alex Iwobi.
90+2' Raul Jimenez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Beto (Everton) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom left corner, but Bernd Leno is prepared and dives to thwart him.
88' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Everton comes to nothing.
88' Beto (Everton) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Everton will have a chance to score from a corner.
86' Dwight McNeil (Everton) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Jarrad Branthwaite comes onto the pitch to replace him.
83' Dwight McNeil (Everton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

82' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) found himself in a promising position. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made a decent save.
81' That's the end of the game for Dominic Calvert-Lewin, who is replaced by Beto (Everton).
80' Abdoulaye Doucoure will be replaced by Orel Mangala (Everton).
79' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Emile Smith Rowe and he is replaced by Harrison Reed (Fulham).
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Harry Wilson (Fulham) coming on for Andreas Pereira.
78' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Raul Jimenez (Fulham) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
78' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
78' A cross into the box from Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is cleared.
76' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by James Tarkowski (Everton) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
75' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
74' The attendance is 38742.
73' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
71' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) commits a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
68' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Adama Traore is replaced by Reiss Nelson (Fulham).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jack Harrison leaves the pitch and Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) comes on.
67' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
65' A pass from Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is intercepted by Jordan Pickford and the move breaks down.
65' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Jack Harrison (Everton) tries his luck but the attempt goes well wide of the right post.

61' 0 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Alex Iwobi (Fulham) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner of the net.
60' A pass from Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is intercepted by Bernd Leno and the move breaks down.
59' Dwight McNeil (Everton) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Bernd Leno.
58' Dangerous play by Kenny Tete (Fulham). John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post.
55' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Antonee Robinson (Fulham).
54' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. John Brooks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
53' Adama Traore (Fulham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
51' Fulham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
50' Adama Traore (Fulham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Jordan Pickford displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Raul Jimenez (Fulham) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
48' Issa Diop (Fulham) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
46' Referee John Brooks blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' The ball falls kindly for Alex Iwobi (Fulham) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies high over the bar.

43' Issa Diop (Fulham) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
43' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

42' Adama Traore (Fulham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.

41' Dwight McNeil (Everton) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Bernd Leno pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
40' John Brooks has a clear sight and sees a foul from James Tarkowski (Everton).
39' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
37' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) shoots from inside the box after his amazing individual effort. He beats the goalkeeper, but hits one of the defending players and it bounces away.
36' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
36' Michael Keane (Everton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Everton will take a corner kick.
35' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes it short.
33' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Everton players look gutted.
33' The Everton players joy may have been justified, because referee John Brooks is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
33' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
33' Crossbar! Idrissa Gueye (Everton) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
30' The corner kick from James Tarkowski (Everton) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
29' The ball is cleared after Jack Harrison (Everton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Everton.
28' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar.

27' Adama Traore (Fulham) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Jordan Pickford makes a great save to stop his effort.
27' A lofted cross from Adama Traore (Fulham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
26' The game is interrupted. Andreas Pereira (Fulham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

25' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) gets to a rebound and attempts to score with a header. Bernd Leno is in the right place at the right time and keeps out the effort which was heading towards the middle of the target.
24' Kenny Tete (Fulham) makes a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
23' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jordan Pickford intercepts the ball.
21' Kenny Tete (Fulham) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.

19' Jack Harrison (Everton) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves John Brooks with no other option than to blow for a foul.
17' Adama Traore (Fulham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
17' Some neat passing and movement from Fulham as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
15' An attempted cross from Idrissa Gueye (Everton) is cleared.
13' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
11' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
10' Adama Traore (Fulham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
10' Jack Harrison (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but Bernd Leno comes off his line to gather the ball.
9' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

7' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the roof of the net, but Jordan Pickford pulls off a great save to deny him.
7' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
6' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Great teamplay by Fulham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' Kenny Tete (Fulham) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.

Fulham will kick-off.
John Brooks will supervise the game today.
